name: last-anomaly-leaves-recap
goal: N2 race forced: Abyss is chained at the first vote, then the real client holding the Mage Occulte (the last anomaly) leaves 1 s into the day-2 vote recap with a 2 s grace, at time scale 1, so the grace expires DURING the recap: the leave victory jumps to GameEndingState while the recap's async flow still awaits. The recap must then NOT advance the loop (host log 'VoteRecapState: no longer the current state'), the game stays on its ending screen (it wrapped back to the lobby before the fix).

expect.cmd: python -X utf8 -c "import sys;sys.exit(0 if 'VoteRecapState: no longer the current state' in open(r'{run}/host.log',encoding='utf-8',errors='replace').read() else 1)"
